resources.string: Offline word predictions (experimental)
English and German next words and short phrases, processed on your phone. Tap a suggestion to accept it.
Prediction model and learned phrases
Manage the English/German model or clear learned phrases

Download the English/German model, then enable offline word predictions in keyboard settings. Tap EN/DE in the suggestion strip to switch language without changing the keys. Hold it to choose or install dictionaries. Your typing stays on your phone. Predictions work without an internet connection after setup. Speed and battery use depend on your device.
Qwen3-0.6B-Base by Qwen, Apache 2.0. Q4_K_M conversion by DevQuasar. Legacy English model: SmolLM2-135M by Hugging Face, conversion by QuantFactory. Inference powered by llama.cpp, MIT license.
